faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in ITBP Head Constable Motor Mechanic Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ITBP has announced 21 Head Constable (Motor Mechanic) vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. When will the online application start?
faq.answer: The online application process will begin on 28 September 2026 at 12:01 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 27 October 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 25 years old. Applicable category relaxation will be provided according to the recruitment rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates need a 10+2 qualification with the prescribed Motor Mechanic certificate and experience or a three-year diploma in Automobile Engineering.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for an ITBP Head Constable Motor Mechanic?
faq.answer: The post carries Pay Level 4, ranging from Rs.25,500 to Rs.81,100.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs.100. SC, ST and eligible ex-servicemen candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the ITBP recruitment portal at recruitment.itbpolice.nic.in.
